title: Saudi-Style Jazzy Broccoli Wrap
description: A flavorful and healthy wrap filled with sautéed broccoli, jazzy spice, and sour sauce, inspired by Saudi cuisine.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tbsp of oil and sauté the broccoli until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the jazzy spice and stir to combine.
Warm the wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spreading sour sauce on the bottom half, followed by a portion of the broccoli mixture.
Fold the bottom half up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrap to form a tight cylinder.
